output.summary: The 30% ticket revenue decline is mostly a venue-relocation effect combined with a regional trend. Revenue stepped down 28.5% when subscription concerts moved to Brightwater. Single-ticket sales fell 45%, against a median of -9% at peers that did not move. Lapsed patrons mostly cite travel and parking, and 71% say they would return downtown. The cathedral, which is central, sold 1,520 tickets per concert against 1,027 at Brightwater. Post-1945 programming does not change per-concert sales, and core renewals are stable at 85%. Peers fell about 29% over the same period, so the total decline is not unusual. Marketing is untested because no attribution data exists. Recommend a segmented analysis before the vote, the cathedral dates and a shuttle pilot, and no non-renewal on revenue grounds.
